def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    P = int(data[0]); K = int(data[1])
    
    k = [ (K * i) % P for i in range(P) ]
    
    if K == 0:
        sys.stdout.write(str(pow(P, P-1, M)) + '\n')
        return
    
    seen = bytearray(P)
    cycle_len = [0] * P
    ans = 1
    
    for i in range(P):
        if seen[i]:
            continue
        cur = i
        seen[cur] = 1
        length = 1
        while not seen[k[cur]]:
            cur = k[cur]
            seen[cur] = 1
            length += 1
        cycle_len[length] += 1
    
    for d in range(1, P):
        cnt = cycle_len[d]
        if cnt == 0:
            continue
        exp = cnt
        base = d * cnt
        if d > 1:
            base += 1
        ans = ans * pow(base, exp, M) % M
    
    sys.stdout.write(str(ans) + '\n')
